description: This file provides firmware functions for the DBGMCU (Debug MCU) module of the STM32F10x microcontroller, including functions to get device revision and ID, and to configure debug behavior during low power modes.

methods.name: DBGMCU_GetREVID
methods.description: Returns the device revision identifier by shifting the IDCODE register right by 16 bits.

methods.name: DBGMCU_GetDEVID
methods.description: Returns the device identifier by masking the IDCODE register with a specific mask.

methods.name: DBGMCU_Config
methods.description: Configures debug and low power mode behavior for peripherals when the MCU is in debug mode, enabling or disabling specific debug features.
